definitions.checkerboard: Nonzero modes with every coordinate index in {0,N/2}: seven joint centered-derivative blind modes.
definitions.nyquist_planes: Union of Fourier planes with any absolute coordinate mode equal to N/2; each coefficient counted once.
definitions.short_wave: Any absolute coordinate mode >= N/4, i.e. wavelength <= four cells in at least one direction.
definitions.short_wave_gradient: Fraction of the sum of squared adjacent-cell differences in the short-wave band.
definitions.gradients: RMS over grid cells of all nine velocity derivatives; centered (u[i+1]-u[i-1])/(2h) and adjacent-cell (u[i+1]-u[i])/h.
definitions.spectra: Bins by max(|m_x|,|m_y|,|m_z|), not spherical shells. Fractions are over all three velocity components.
definitions.normalization: Unnormalized forward real FFT; double reduced-axis interior powers, once at DC and Nyquist; Parseval checked against direct grid energy.

limits: Measures sampled arrays only; cannot detect content that aliased before sampling or lies above grid resolution.
The short-wave cutoff is an inspection band, not a universal accuracy threshold; its physical wavelength differs by grid.
Neither discrete gradient is an exact continuum derivative. The gap includes ordinary finite-difference attenuation of resolved modes.
Joint blind modes, Nyquist planes and the broader short-wave band are nested and must not be added together.
Saved times do not resolve intervening events; floating-point tails near roundoff should not be interpreted as physical signals.
No new fluid evolution, filtering, or external force was applied. This supplies no rigorous error bound or Clay proof.
